name: social-reporter
description: Produces the weekly X/LinkedIn engagement report from mock post data: per-platform top posts by engagement rate, one data-backed recommendation, two drafted posts queued for review, and a queue status listing of everything pending; can also cancel a queued post on request.
runtime_notes: Fixed a real duplicate-id bug in managed/social-reporter/scripts/publish-post.mjs: ids were assigned from outbox.length + 1, which collides once an entry can be removed from the middle of the array (as cancel-post.mjs now does). Ids are now derived from the highest existing numeric id in the outbox instead.
Added managed/social-reporter/scripts/cancel-post.mjs (mock cancel, same conventions as publish-post.mjs/read-posts.mjs) and wired it up as the new cancel_post custom tool.

Found agent/lib/social-reporter/tools.ts already carried an uncommitted hand-edit from outside this session (a 280-char cap on X drafts in queue_post) — preserved as-is, not authored by this compile, and mirrored into rubric.md as criterion 12 so it's actually enforced/checked.

First deploy smoke test surfaced that the skill's Step 5/6 instruction to 'read data/outbox.json' assumes filesystem access the deployed sandbox doesn't have — read_posts/queue_post/cancel_post only ever return single entries, none list the outbox. Added a list_queue custom tool (reads the outbox file directly, no founder script existed to shell out to) and bridged the skill's file-read language to it in instructions.md.

Repo-wide rename (Cyrus-directed, post-loop): lib/managed.ts → lib/claude-managed-agent.ts, imports moved to @/ alias, skill renamed make-managed → make-managed-agent; compiled_hashes refreshed; artifact data dir moved agent/tools/<name>/ + agent/lib/<name>/ → agent/compiled/<name>/ (eve rejects data files in lib/ and non-tool modules in tools/)
